literal: In that eleventh month, day Wuxu, the moon transgressed the Upper General star.
idiomatic: That November, on the Wuxu day, the Moon drew too near the star of the senior commander.

literal: Fifth year, first month: Shi Jilong usurped a title and called himself emperor; soon he died.
idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, Shi Hu seized the imperial style and declared himself emperor, then died not long after.

literal: Fifth year, fourth month, day Dingwei: Taibai transgressed Eastern Well.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year, on Dingwei, Venus trespassed against the Well asterism in the east.

literal: Divination text says: Qin will have soldiers.
idiomatic: The prognostication reads that Qin would see armed conflict.

literal: Ninth month, day Wuxu: Taibai transgressed the left horn.
idiomatic: On the Wuxu day of the ninth month, Venus closed on the left horn of the Azure Dragon.

literal: Divination text says: It becomes soldiers.
idiomatic: The omen was interpreted as widespread warfare.

literal: Tenth month: the moon transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: In the tenth month the Moon passed against the Pleiades lodge.

literal: Divination text says: The Hu will have grief; generals will die.
idiomatic: The reading warned of trouble for the steppe peoples and the death of commanders.

literal: That year, eighth month: Chu Pou's northern-campaign troops were defeated.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of the same year, Chu Pou's northern expedition met disaster.

literal: Tenth month: within Guanzhong more than twenty raised troops and submitted inward.
idiomatic: In the tenth month over twenty uprisings in Guanzhong yielded and came over to the court.

literal: Shi Zun attacked and extinguished Nanyang.
idiomatic: Shi Zun took Nanyang by force.

literal: Eleventh month: Ran Min killed Shi Zun, also entirely killed Hu more than one hundred thousand persons; thereupon Zhao and Wei great chaos.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Ran Min slew Shi Zun and massacred well over a hundred thousand Hu, throwing Zhao and the heartland into turmoil.

literal: Twelfth month: Chu Pou died.
idiomatic: Chu Pou passed away in the twelfth month.

literal: Eighth year: Liu Xian, Fu Jian, Murong Jun together usurped titles.
idiomatic: In the eighth year Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun each proclaimed illegitimate royal styles.

literal: Yin Hao north-campaigned, met defeat, was seen dismissed.
idiomatic: Yin Hao's northern campaign collapsed and he was stripped of office.

literal: Sixth year, second month, day Xinyou: the moon transgressed the great star of Heart.
idiomatic: On Xinyou in the second month of the sixth year, the Moon crossed the chief star of the Heart mansion.

literal: Divination text says: Great men will have grief; moreover it is Yuzhou field division.
idiomatic: The text foretold sorrow for high dignitaries and pointed to the celestial field of Yuzhou.

literal: Day Dingchou: the moon transgressed Room.
idiomatic: On Dingchou the Moon impinged on the Room lodge.

literal: Divination text says: Generals and ministers will have grief.
idiomatic: The omen spoke of danger to leading generals and ministers.

literal: Sixth month, day Jichou: moon transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: On Jichou in the sixth month the Moon trespassed the Mao cluster.

literal: Divination: same as above.
idiomatic: The prognostication matched the preceding gloss.

literal: Day Yiwei: moon transgressed Five Feudal Lords.
idiomatic: On Yiwei the Moon neared the Five Feudal Lords stars.

literal: Divination: same as above.
idiomatic: The same divinatory formula applied again.

literal: Seventh month, day Renyin: the moon first came out in the west, transgressed left horn.
idiomatic: On Renyin in the seventh month, as the Moon first rose in the west it crossed the left horn.

literal: Divination text says: The grand general will die.
idiomatic: The reading predicted the death of a grand general.

literal: One says: Under heaven there will be soldiers.
idiomatic: An alternate gloss warned of war throughout the realm.

literal: Day Dingwei: moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.
idiomatic: On Dingwei the Moon closed on the Winnowing-Basket stars.

literal: Divination text says: Generals will die.
idiomatic: The omen indicated a general would perish.

literal: Day Bingyin: Mars transgressed the hatchet star.
idiomatic: On Bingyin Mars drew near the axe-shaped star.

literal: Divination text says: Great ministers will have execution.
idiomatic: The text foretold senior ministers facing capital punishment.

literal: Eighth month, day Xinmao: moon transgressed left horn.
idiomatic: On Xinmao in the eighth month the Moon crossed the left horn.

literal: Taibai was seen by day, in Southern Dipper.
idiomatic: Venus appeared in daylight within the Southern Dipper.

literal: Moon transgressed Right Law-Enforcer.
idiomatic: The Moon passed against the right court official star in Supreme Palace.

literal: Divinations together same as above.
idiomatic: Every listed prognostication repeated the earlier ones.

literal: That year: Minister of Education Cai Mo was dismissed and became commoner.
idiomatic: In the same year Minister over the Masses Cai Mo was degraded to commoner status.

literal: Seventh year, second month: Taibai transgressed Mao.
idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year Venus crossed the Mao asterism.

literal: Divination: same as above.
idiomatic: The divination matched the prior entry.

literal: Third month, day Yimao: Mars entered Ghost Cart, transgressed Heap Corpses.
idiomatic: On Yimao in the third month Mars entered the Ghost asterism and touched the Heap of Corpses.

literal: Divination text says: Noble men will have grief.
idiomatic: The gloss warned of misfortune for persons of high rank.

literal: Fifth month, day Yiwei: Mars transgressed the great star of Coach-and-Thongs.
idiomatic: On Yiwei in the fifth month Mars neared the chief star of the Coach constellation.

literal: Divination text says: The chief lady will have grief.
idiomatic: The reading pointed to trouble for the empress or dowager.

literal: Taibai entered Net mouth, transgressed left thigh.
idiomatic: Venus entered the gap of the Net and crossed its left thigh star.

literal: Divination text says: Generals and ministers will match it.
idiomatic: The omen was said to fall on generals and ministers.

literal: Sixth month, day Yihai: moon transgressed Winnowing-Basket.
idiomatic: On Yihai in the sixth month the Moon crossed the Winnowing-Basket.

literal: Divination text says: The state will have soldiers.
idiomatic: The text predicted internal or external war for the dynasty.

literal: Day Bingzi: moon transgressed Dipper.
idiomatic: On Bingzi the Moon trespassed the Dipper handle stars.

literal: Day Dingchou: Mars entered Supreme Subtlety, transgressed Right Law-Enforcer.
idiomatic: On Dingchou Mars entered the Forbidden Enclosure and crossed the right court star.

literal: Eighth month, day Gengwu: Taibai transgressed Coach-and-Thongs.
idiomatic: On Gengwu in the eighth month Venus brushed the Coach stars.

literal: Day Wuzi: Taibai transgressed Right Law-Enforcer.
idiomatic: On Wuzi Venus crossed the right Law-Enforcer.

literal: Divinations all entirely same as above.
idiomatic: All associated prognostications repeated the same formulas.

literal: Seventh year: Liu Xian killed Shi Zhi and various commanders; east of mountains great chaos; pestilence and death.
idiomatic: In the seventh year Liu Xian slew Shi Zhi and many generals; Shandong erupted in disorder with plague and heavy mortality.

literal: Eighth year, third month, day Wuxu: moon transgressed great star of Coach.
idiomatic: On Wuxu in the third month of the eighth year the Moon neared the chief Coach star.

literal: Day Guichou: moon entered Southern Dipper, transgressed the second star.
idiomatic: On Guichou the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed its second star.

literal: Fifth month: moon transgressed Heart star.
idiomatic: In the fifth month the Moon impinged on the Heart.

literal: Sixth month, day Guiyou: moon transgressed Room.
idiomatic: On Guiyou in the sixth month the Moon crossed the Room lodge.

literal: Seventh month, day Renzi: Sui star transgressed Eastern Well distance star.
idiomatic: On Renzi in the seventh month Jupiter passed the separator star of the Well.

literal: Divination text says: Internal chaos; soldiers arise.
idiomatic: The reading warned of civil strife and mobilization.

literal: Eighth month, day Wuxu: Mars entered Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: On Wuxu in the eighth month Mars entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: Divination text says: Loyal ministers are slaughtered to death.
idiomatic: The gloss foretold loyal ministers being put to the sword.

literal: Day Bingchen: Taibai entered Southern Dipper, transgressed fourth star.
idiomatic: On Bingchen Venus entered the Dipper and crossed its fourth star.

literal: Divination text says: Generals will bring disorder.
idiomatic: The omen warned that commanders would stir revolt.

literal: One says: Chancellor will be dismissed.
idiomatic: A variant reading predicted the chief minister would be removed.

literal: Ninth year, second month, day Yisi: moon entered Southern Dipper, transgressed third star.
idiomatic: On Yisi in the second month of the ninth year the Moon entered the Dipper and crossed the third star.

literal: Third month, day Wuchen: moon transgressed Room.
idiomatic: On Wuchen in the third month the Moon trespassed Room.

literal: Eighth month: Sui star transgressed Ghost Cart southeast star.
idiomatic: In the eighth month Jupiter crossed the southeastern star of Ghost.

literal: Divination text says: Soldiers arise.
idiomatic: The prognostication was simply that arms would rise.

literal: At that time the emperor was young-rushing; empress mother held the system; generals and ministers had cracks; armor and leather arose in succession; Murong Jun usurped title and called Yan king; attack and punish without rest.
idiomatic: The throne was held by a child, the empress dowager ruled, factions split the high command, fighting spread without pause, Murong Jun styled himself king of Yan, and campaigns continued endlessly.

literal: Tenth year, first month, day Yimao: moon ate Mao star.
idiomatic: On Yimao in the first month of the tenth year the Moon occulted a star in Mao.

literal: Divination text says: Zhao and Wei will have soldiers.
idiomatic: The text predicted warfare in the Zhao and Wei heartland sectors.

literal: Day Guiyou: Fill star covered the hatchet star.
idiomatic: On Guiyou Saturn passed over and hid the axe star.

literal: Divination text says: Axes and halberds will be used.
idiomatic: The reading pointed to executions and military justice.

literal: Second month, day Jiashen: moon transgressed great star of Heart.
idiomatic: On Jiashen in the second month the Moon crossed the great Heart star.

literal: Divination text says: The king will hate it.
idiomatic: The omen was deemed ill for the sovereign.

literal: Seventh month, day Gengwu: Taibai seen by day.
idiomatic: On Gengwu in the seventh month Venus shone in daylight.

literal: By gnomon degrees pushed, the calamity lies in Qin and Zheng.
idiomatic: Shadow-length reckoning placed the disaster in the Qin and Zheng celestial fields.

literal: Ninth month, day Xinyou: Taibai transgressed Left Law-Enforcer.
idiomatic: On Xinyou in the ninth month Venus crossed the left court star.

literal: At that time Huan Wen monopolized orders; court ministers many were seen forced.
idiomatic: Huan Wen dominated policy while numerous officials lived under duress.

literal: Fourth month: Wen campaigned against Fu Jian, broke his Yaoliu army.
idiomatic: In the fourth month Huan Wen struck Fu Jian and routed the Yaoliu contingent.

literal: Twelfth month: Murong Ke attacked Qi.
idiomatic: Murong Ke invaded Qi in the twelfth month.

literal: Eleventh year, third month, day Xinhai: moon covered Coach-and-Thongs.
idiomatic: On Xinhai in the third month of the eleventh year the Moon passed over the Coach stars.

literal: Divination: same as above.
idiomatic: The prognostication duplicated the earlier gloss.

literal: Fourth month, day Gengyin: moon transgressed Ox mansion south star.
idiomatic: On Gengyin in the fourth month the Moon crossed the southern Ox star.

literal: Divination text says: The state will have grief.
idiomatic: The reading augured mourning or crisis for the realm.

literal: Eighth month, day Jiwei: Taibai transgressed Celestial River.
idiomatic: On Jiwei in the eighth month Venus crossed the Celestial River band.

literal: Divination text says: River ferries will not pass.
idiomatic: The omen warned that major crossings would be blocked.

literal: Twelfth year, sixth month, day Gengzi: Taibai seen by day, in Eastern Well.
idiomatic: On Gengzi in the sixth month of the twelfth year Venus appeared by day within the Well.

literal: Divination as above.
idiomatic: The divination matched those already cited.

literal: Day Jiwei: moon transgressed hatchet star.
idiomatic: On Jiwei the Moon drew near the axe star.

literal: Eighth month, day Guiyou: moon covered Establishment star.
idiomatic: On Guiyou in the eighth month the Moon occulted a star of Establishment.

literal: Ninth month, day Wuyin: Mars entered Supreme Subtlety, transgressed western bastion Upper General star.
idiomatic: On Wuyin in the ninth month Mars entered the Forbidden Enclosure and crossed the western senior commander star.

literal: Eleventh month, day Dingchou: Mars transgressed Supreme Subtlety eastern bastion Upper Minister star.
idiomatic: On Dingchou in the eleventh month Mars crossed the eastern chief minister star of the enclosure.

literal: Twelfth year, eleventh month: Qi city fell; Duan Kan was seized; killed more than three thousand persons.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Qi fell, Duan Kan was captured, and over three thousand died.

literal: Yonghe third year: Xianbei raided and invaded He and Ji.
idiomatic: In the third year of Yonghe Xianbei forces harried the He and Ji corridors.

literal: Shengping first year: Murong Jun then occupied Linzhang, entirely had You, Bing, Qing, Ji lands.
idiomatic: In the first year of Shengping Murong Jun seized Linzhang and brought You, Bing, Qing, and Ji under his control.

literal: Along-river various generals ran scattered; river ferries were cut off.
idiomatic: Riverine commanders fled in disorder and bridges and fords were severed.

literal: At that time power lay in the regional shepherds; the nine circuits crossed blades.
idiomatic: Real authority rested with regional governors while fighting spread across the subcelestial realm.

literal: Shengping first year, fourth month, day Renzi: Taibai entered Ghost Cart.
idiomatic: On Renzi in the fourth month of Shengping year one Venus entered the Ghost asterism.

literal: Day Dinghai: moon covered Well south axle west head second star.
idiomatic: On Dinghai the Moon covered the second star at the western end of the Well's southern shaft.

literal: Divination text says: Qin land will have soldiers.
idiomatic: The prognostication assigned armed trouble to the Qin field.

literal: One says: Generals will die.
idiomatic: A second reading predicted a general's death.
